added.text: How much does Alpha Progression Pro cost, and how does the free trial work?
When the trial ends, the annual price shown at sign-up is charged in one payment unless you cancel before your provider's deadline.
With a free Alpha Progression account, your training data syncs to the cloud when you're signed in and back online.
Guest-account data is stored only on your device.
